categories.question: Your friends draw four clues for a woodland treasure hunt. Which object do you volunteer to find?

outcomes.name: A feather shaped like a quill
outcomes.description: Long dark naturally shed feather with a cream tip and elegantly curved shaft

outcomes.name: A leaf with a heart-shaped hole
outcomes.description: Fresh green broad leaf with a clear naturally nibbled heart-shaped hole

outcomes.name: A stone with a white stripe
outcomes.description: Smooth grey river stone bisected by a single broad white quartz stripe

outcomes.name: A forked twig like antlers
outcomes.description: Small brown fallen branch with symmetrical forks resembling deer antlers
